content.text:
I changed the HTTP adapter so that request bodies have no size limit by default, whatever `maxRedirects` is set to. I haven't run any tests or tried the issue's reproduction cases after the change.

**Cause:** axios's default `maxBodyLength` is `-1`, meaning unlimited. But `lib/adapters/http.js` only passed the setting on to `follow-redirects` when it was greater than `-1`. Otherwise `follow-redirects` fell back to its own 10MB default. With `maxRedirects: 0`, axios skips `follow-redirects` entirely, so there was no limit at all. That's why the results differed.

**Fix:** in `lib/adapters/http.js`, when `maxBodyLength` is `-1`, axios now explicitly passes `Infinity` to `follow-redirects`. So:
- the default and an explicit `maxBodyLength: -1` should both allow the 100MB body from the issue;
- any positive value you set is still passed through as before.

**Docs:** I added one line to the `maxBodyLength` comment in `README.md` saying the default is `-1` (unlimited), regardless of `maxRedirects`.
